Mobile Suit Gundam: Requiem for Vengeance Movie Releases Second Official Trailer!

The second official trailer for Mobile Suit Gundam: Requiem for Vengeance has been released by Netflix. The movie is set to premiere exclusively on Netflix on October 17.

Official Trailer:

STAFF:
Director: Erasmus Brosdau (The Lord Inquisitor).
Scriptwriter: Gavin Hignight
Main character designer: Manuel Augusto Dischinger Moura
Music composer: Wilbert Roget II
Mechanical designer: Kimitoshi Yamane
Animation Production: Sunrise, SAFEHOUSE

“Gundam: Requiem for Vengeance” is an all-new original animation composed of six 30-minute episodes focusing on the European front of the One Year War, which was the setting of the first Gundam series, “Mobile Suit Gundam.” Produced in collaboration with SAFEHOUSE using Unreal Engine 5, the series is written by Gavin Hignight, who wrote the animated series “Tekken: Bloodline” and “Transformers: Cyberverse,” as well as the video game “Marvel’s Spider-Man,” and is directed by Erasmus Brosdau, who has also worked on the animated series “Resident Evil: Infinite Darkness” and the video games “Star Citizen,” “Ryse: Son of Rome” and the “Crysis” series.

Sources: AnimeJapan, Netflix Anime

The Mononoke film was revealed during the 15th-anniversary event for the 2007 Mononoke series in June 2022, with an initial aim for release in 2023. Mononoke originates as a spin-off from the 2006 series Ayakashi: Samurai Horror Tales.

Crunchyroll describes the Mononoke series as:

In feudal Japan, evil spirits known as mononoke plague the countryside, leaving a trail of fear in their wake. One mysterious person has the power to slay the mononoke where they stand; he is known as the Medicine Seller, and he vanquishes the spirits using the power of his Exorcism Sword. In order to draw his sword he must understand the Form, Truth and Reason of the mononoke. Armed with a sharp wit, the Medicine Seller wanders from place to place, striking down the evil spirits in his wake.
